tool_args.rationale: The archived two-layer siphon law with a negative square-root branch reproduces all five paid observations to their rounding precision. The numerical fit gives vmax ≈ 7.538, rho ≈ 0.698, and a branch coefficient ≈ -0.457. All pilot rows are at the target horizon H = 0.6, so submit this law for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its pilot RMSE is 0.0171, versus less than 1e-8 for the negative square-root branch on the same five rows with the same parameter count.
The pilot already spans sink gradients from 0.25 to 2.20 and distinguishes the branch forms at the recorded precision.
The static law explains the pilot at the target horizon without a trajectory-dependent term; there is no residual evidence that warrants fitting a coupled ODE.
